name: HICAP — Free Medicare Counselling
description: Free, confidential and unbiased counselling on Medicare from the California Department of Aging. HICAP is not selling anything, which makes it the right first call for anyone weighing Medicare against Medi-Cal, or both together.
fullDescription: Free, confidential and unbiased counselling on Medicare from the California Department of Aging. HICAP is not selling anything, which makes it the right first call for anyone weighing Medicare against Medi-Cal, or both together.
whatTheyOffer:
- One-to-one help understanding Medicare Parts A, B, C and D
- How Medicare and Medi-Cal work together for people who qualify for both
- Help filing an appeal or challenging a denial
- Guidance on prescription drug coverage, co-pays and eligibility rules
- Advice on long-term care insurance
- Community education talks
howToGetIt: Call 1-800-434-0222 to be connected to the HICAP office for your county, or find your local office on the California Department of Aging website. The service is free and there is no income limit.
keywords: HICAP, Medicare, Medi-Cal, dual eligible, Medicare Savings Program, Part A, Part B, Part D, prescription drug coverage, appeal, denial, long-term care insurance, counselling, free, unbiased, seniors
